title: centella montana
intro: Centella montana, commonly known as Indian pennywort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Mackinlayaceae. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine to treat various health conditions, including skin disorders, inflammation, and cognitive impairment. The health benefits of Centella montana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to improve skin health, reduce oxidative stress, and boost cognitive function. The bioactive constituents of Centella montana include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, such as madecassoside and asiaticoside, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
